title: Zoe member stories
description: A full-bleed deep-teal band: a small eyebrow and a big white semibold heading over a row of pale-mint quote cards (16px radius), each with a large faint serif quote mark at the top and the quote and name at the bottom. A centred row on desktop; on phones a swipeable slider with a progress bar and translucent round arrows. The quote marks fade in as they enter view.
notes: the band is the highlight colour with highlight-foreground text; cards are the muted colour
four cards fit in one row from 1024px; below that they slide (hydrate visible)
